No. `bun tools/check-register.ts` exited 0 and reports 0 entries at Likelihood 3 or higher that are not settled. It scanned 436 items and found 0 settled entries missing a `Verified` line, 0 Moved Out for a reason other than a part `plugins/` doesn't ship, and 0 with two Likelihood values.

The checker reads only the last `Status:` in each entry. I listed the entries with more than one `Status:` at Likelihood 3 or higher with a separate script. There are 38, and the last status in every one is settled. I cut some reasons short here, and I haven't read the full text of the few entries whose last status was cut off in my listing.

**Current status is `mitigated` unless marked otherwise.** The reasons are the ones the entry records.

- **Earlier status was open (RISK-401, RISK-411, RISK-374):**
  - RISK-401 (L5, setup): ADR-0188 block, no EPERM on routine writes.
  - RISK-411 (L3, setup): the session-start fill removes the retired text.
  - RISK-374 (L5, cost): the spawn-depth and concurrency caps take effect, and Opus and Fable spawns are refused. It was "partial" before.
- **Fixed by shipped agent files (RISK-170, RISK-199, RISK-223):** the entries record a `Verified` line.
- **Fixed by a setting or test (RISK-222, RISK-424):**
  - RISK-222 (L4): `CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL` moves a no-model subagent off Opus.
  - RISK-424 (L3): the threshold test pins the literal 70000.
- **Backed by fixture results against vanilla (mitigated 2026-11-19):**
  - RISK-226 (L4), RISK-262 (L5), RISK-264 (L5), RISK-278 (L4), RISK-352 (L5), RISK-353 (L5), RISK-362 (L5): the defect paragraph in `output-styles/claudetto.md` beats vanilla on two fixtures and holds level on both controls.
  - RISK-227 (L3): the output style plus the redact guard beat vanilla on two fixtures (env1 5/6 vs 1/6, env2 6/6 vs 0/6).
  - RISK-497 (L4): line 3 beats vanilla on two fixtures (6/6 vs 0/6 and 4/6 vs 0/6).
  - RISK-171 (L4): the consent paragraph in the output style and the agent files.
  - RISK-185 (L3) and RISK-451 (L4): read a background command's output before replying, and background exit status.
  - RISK-416 (L5): the single-`perl -pi` line for a repeated change.
- **Fixed in the rules or guards (mitigated 2026-11-19):**
  - RISK-053 (L4): the wall guard now folds the `~/./`, `~//`, `~/x/..` spellings and an unclosed `[`, which had passed it for a sandbox-off call (#42).
  - RISK-067 (L4): the ask rules cover stash, hard reset, clean and `branch -D`, also in the `git -C dir` form.
  - RISK-103 (L4): the `git -C` prefix form had bypassed the rules, and the fix was probed.
  - RISK-132 (L4): the handover keeps user corrections and refusals word for word.
  - RISK-186 (L5): the Bash wrapper's `{ ... } </dev/null` group made git commands in an isolated worktree non-simple (bb4fdbf4, issue #45).
- **Withdrawn acceptance (RISK-391, RISK-393):** both are L3 and mitigated 2026-11-19. The fill writes no `Bash(claude -p *)` allow and removes the old one, so a paid `claude -p` run meets the vanilla permission prompt. An earlier status accepted the risk on ADR-0188's allow rule. The entries record that the acceptance was the user's to give and was withdrawn.
- **Closed:**
  - RISK-410 (L4): the cause is outside claudetto (OUT-866, ADR-0190). It also carried an `open` status in between.
  - RISK-166 (L4): not reproduced on vanilla 2.1.327.
  - RISK-169 (L4): the SubagentStop/Stop guard is removed (ADR-0092, OUT-016), and the likelihood stays 4 as accepted engine behaviour.
  - RISK-055 (L4), RISK-063 (L3), RISK-064 (L4): the entries record permission prompts for `pkill`/`killall`, destructive git and the user settings file, plus the deny rules and sandbox.
  - RISK-059 (L3) and RISK-071 (L5): the gate texts are dropped (OUT-035, OUT-021). The entries record that a `git grep` finds no hit.
  - RISK-463 (L3): the fault stayed out of 24 of 24 target runs.
- **Moved Out (RISK-462, L4):** OUT-2777. The checker accepts its reason as a part `plugins/` doesn't ship.

My statuses script is in `$TMPDIR/rr/statuses.ts`, and its full output is in `all.txt` beside it.
